articles.title: Charlotte city officials demand Iryna Zarutska's wrongful death lawsuit is dismissed after she was massacred on light rail train by thug

articles.title: Fidan says Mecca defense alliance could expand
articles.summary: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said on Nov. 17 that Türkiye, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan would welcome other countries into their Mecca defense alliance once its institutional framework is in place.
